definitions.explanation: Edible seaweed, typically dried into thin sheets. A staple ingredient in Japanese cuisine used for wrapping sushi, rice balls, and as a topping or garnish.

examples.japanese: ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{海苔|のり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧。
examples.english: To wrap a rice ball in nori.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧{海苔|のり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Seasoned nori is popular with children.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海苔|のり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

notes:
{海苔|のり} refers to edible seaweed, especially the dried sheets used in Japanese cooking. Not to be confused with ⟦{糊|のり}→糊：03895_nori⟧ (glue, paste), which is a different word.

TYPES:
- {焼|や}き{海苔|のり}: toasted nori (plain sheets)
- ⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧{海苔|のり}: seasoned nori (with soy sauce and salt flavoring)
- {板海苔|いたのり}: sheet nori

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海苔|のり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wrap with nori)
- {海苔|のり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ちぎる (to tear nori)
- {海苔|のり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{佃煮|つくだに}→佃煮：04970_tsukudani⟧ (nori simmered in soy sauce)

CULTURAL NOTE: Nori is one of the most common ingredients in Japanese daily life, used in everything from ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧ and ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧ to ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧ toppings. Japan is the world's largest consumer of nori.
